# Crate index

<p class="pm-kind"><b>Reference · generated</b> · every workspace crate by tier, with the description its manifest carries</p>

A tier depends only on the tiers below it; the peripheral surface depends on all of them and is depended on by none. The description column is each crate's `Cargo.toml` description, so this table is exactly what `cargo metadata` reports. The status column is the crate's `package.metadata.pulse-mesh.status`: `pre-integration` for a crate the tree ships but does not use yet (ADR-0014), `partial` for one in use some of whose public entry points return a deferred error (ADR-0017), blank for one that is finished and wired in.

## The enterprise ring (tier 3, `rings/enterprise_ring/`)

| Crate | Path | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enterprise-core` | `rings/enterprise_ring/enterprise-core` |  | Pulse Mesh — enterprise_ring core layer: shared types for the ring's functions and stages. Empty by design; kept so the four-crate shape is uniform. |
| `enterprise-functions` | `rings/enterprise_ring/enterprise-functions` |  | Pulse Mesh — enterprise_ring functions layer: stateless primitives. Empty by design; kept so the four-crate shape is uniform. |
| `enterprise-hub` | `rings/enterprise_ring/enterprise-hub` |  | Pulse Mesh — enterprise_ring hub layer: the ring's import point; re-exports core, functions and stages and emits the ring manifest. |
| `enterprise-stages` | `rings/enterprise_ring/enterprise-stages` | partial | Pulse Mesh — enterprise_ring stages layer: the wire transport's frames over TLS 1.3 on TCP (rustls), with the DTLS and QUIC-tunnel modes deferred. |

## The HFT ring (tier 3, `rings/hft_ring/`)

|---|---|---|---|

| `hft-stages` | `rings/hft_ring/hft-stages` |  | Pulse Mesh — hft_ring stages layer: NUMA hugepage placement, the MultiLane striped rings and the SPMC ring. |

## The peripheral surface (tier peripheral, `tools/`, `examples/`, `plugins/`)

| Crate | Path | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `example-enterprise-01-tls-stage-rust` | `examples/enterprise-01-tls-stage-rust` |  | Example — the enterprise ring's TLS stage reached through its hub: a TLS 1.3 handshake on loopback with a certificate the example makes, one frame sent and received, and what the deferred DTLS mode reports. |
| `example-robotics-01-large-payload-rust` | `examples/robotics-01-large-payload-rust` |  | Example — the robotics ring's large-payload pool reached through its hub: a 4 MiB scan written in one process and read in another, its 16-byte reference carried in a Pulse's data area, and the segment freed for the next scan. |
| `pms-telemetry` | `tools/hft-telemetry` |  | Pulse Mesh scheduling-pressure probes for the hft ring's wait strategies: a PSI probe reading /proc/pressure/cpu on Linux, and an adaptive strategy that parks while pressure is high. |
| `pulse-wire-xdp` | `plugins/hft-xdp` |  | The Pulse Mesh UDP transport's frames over AF_XDP on Linux: a sender that writes them into a NIC queue's TX ring, and a receiver whose XDP program hands it the queue's packets for its port. |
